risk_if_not_implemented: Without Telecommunications Equipment, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Wireless Networking
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to control authorized wireless usage and monitor for unauthorized wireless access.
compensating_control_1.justification: Wireless Networking (NET-24) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Telecommunications Equipment (AST-31) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Telecommunications Equipment (AST-31) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
